ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወልዶ: ወልድ — his son (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted)
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
ተሰምዩ: ሰምየ — they were called (passive ተሰምየ, 3mp perfect)
በኵረ: በኵር — firstborn (noun, accusative, in apposition to ደቂቅክሙ 'as firstborn')
ወእለኒ: እለ — and those also (ወ- + relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ይንበሩ: ነበረ — that they live (3mp subjunctive, n-b-r)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ይነብሩ: ነበረ — they live, dwell (3mp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct)
ለወልዱ: ወልድ — to his son (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word')
ገባር: ገባር — workman, labourer (noun; agent noun of ገብረ)
ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
ወሰረገላተ: ሰረገላ — and carts, chariots (ወ- + plural ሰረገላት, accusative)
ወአብቅልተ: በቅል — and mules (ወ- + plural አብቅልት, accusative)
ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
ወሜላተ: ሜላ — and (a dyed stuff) (ወ- + noun, accusative; unidentified, uncertain, perhaps purple)
ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct) · upon (ለ- marking the place shone upon: አብርሀት ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'she shone upon the land of Ethiopia') · of the land of (ለ- marking the possessor: ሥርዐታ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'the custom of the land of Ethiopia')
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ለመኳንንተ: መኰንን — to the nobles of (ለ- + plural መኳንንት, construct; the ለ- repeats the -ሎሙ of the verb)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun)
ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
ኀየሰ: ኀየሰ — he excelled, was good (3ms perfect, ḫ-y-s)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ለአምላከ: አምላክ — of the God of (ለ- genitive + noun, construct) · marking the object: 'the God of' after ያመልኩ/ይግነዩ (ይግነዩ ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'serve the God of Israel')
ወይብልዎ: ብህለ — and they say to him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ)
ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
ገጾሙ: ገጽ — their faces (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written ገጾሙ)
ያአምር: አእመረ — he knows, discerns (3ms imperfect, caus., ʿ-m-r)
ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
ወአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — and the ends of (ወ- + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ይኴንን: ኰነነ — he rule, judge (3ms imperfect/jussive, D)
ወለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and to the king of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct)
ለእኪት: እኪት — evil (fem. adj./noun, ለ- marking object)
ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
